reason: The hypothesis directly restates the cryo-rolling and annealing treatment from P7 on the same AlCoCrFeNi2.1 alloy, uses the same hierarchical microstructure and back-stress mechanism, and predicts the same simultaneous strength-ductility enhancement already reported in P7 and P3. The proposed mechanism of modifying phase boundary coherence to reduce dislocation pile-ups is taken from P1 and P13, and the problem of pile-up-induced microcracks is described in P19. No new alloy, regime, or integration of conflicting evidence is introduced; the idea is a textbook application of a known process to a known material with a known outcome.
